svg.title: electron/electron: 50% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 50% of 487 recent commits in electron/electron carry a disclosed AI agent signature (newest 487 commits, since 2026-09-06). Claude Code 45%, GitHub Copilot 4.5%, OpenAI Codex 0.6%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
